newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge hits new highs on ratings upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge hits new highs on ratings upgrade.

text.p: Telecommunications equipment firm Newbridge Networks Corp surged to a new high on Wednesday on the back of a ratings upgrade by New York-based brokerage Alex Brown following days of gains.
Analyst Mike Gordon Alex. Brown upgraded Newbridge to a strong buy from a buy on Wednesday.

Shares in the Ottawa-based firm jumped 0.55 to 57.80 on the Toronto Stock Exchange in mid-afternoon turnover of 1.8 million shares, relinquishing earlier gains which pushed it to 60. In New York, Newbridge rose 1/8 to 41-7/8 in trading of over a million shares after posting a high of 43-1/2.
"Newbridge has the momentum going for it," said another analyst who declined to be identified. "They're back in favor."

Newbridge shares rose yesterday in concert with the news that it and strategic partner Siemens AG were chosen by Swiss Telecom to provide an asynchronous transfer mode (ATM) network to link larger Swiss cities.
This sale of Newbridge's flagship telephone equipment was a major deal and worth several tens of millions, the analyst said.

Newbridge has surged in recent sessions as investors have returned to the high technology sector, shunning small mining issues following the discovery of several gold scams. The largest was Bre-X Minerals Ltd, which touted its Busang gold deposit in Indonesia as the world's largest and then turned out to be a fraud.
"Because of the recent disappointment with mining stocks, people are looking back at high tech," the analyst said.

High tech U.S. issues have powered higher, pulling Canadians in their wake since they are comparatively undervalued, the analyst said. "Newbridge is, compared to the others, in an even better position because they have to broaden their portfolios," he said. He had a TSE target price of 65 in a year.
((Lydia Zajc, Reuters Toronto Bureau (416) 941-8109 or lydia.zajc@reuters.com))
